decisions.shape: list[int] (length = total number of pieces N, elements 0 or 1)
decisions.business: Whether each piece is selected for cutting. example: [1, 1, 0]. List all pieces, including unselected ones (value 0)

Horizontal coordinate of each piece's bottom-left corner (meaningful only when selected; forced to 0 when not selected). example: [0.0, 30.0, 0.0]. List all pieces; set the coordinate to 0 when not selected
Vertical coordinate of each piece's bottom-left corner. example: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. List all pieces; set the coordinate to 0 when not selected

decisions.shape: list[list[int]] (N×N matrix, row i, column j, elements 0 or 1, 0 on the diagonal)
decisions.business: Whether piece i lies entirely to the left of piece j (x[i]+w_i ≤ x[j]). example: [[0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]]. Include every pair i,j (0≤i,j<N); set the diagonal to 0

decisions.shape: list[list[int]] (N×N matrix, row i, column j, elements 0 or 1, 0 on the diagonal)
decisions.business: Whether piece i lies entirely below piece j (y[i]+h_i ≤ y[j]). example: [[0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]]. Include every pair i,j
